_comment: X-BN, the extra batch's BUILDINGNUM top-up (D-64d, m2; the team, 23 Oct: B3 flags BUILDINGNUM 90.8 -> 81.6 on v4.2). Merged over quotas.json: every document is a building pair (decoy_pair, group building) and building_v43.rate of them use the shapes v4.2 lost (frames_v43, task log extra_batch_buildingnum.md); the rest keep D-57 S4's shapes. Run: build_targeted_corpus.py -n 600 --seed <s> --quotas scripts/piigen/targeted/quotas_x_buildingnum.json -o <out>. Not with --stats: the protected kinds of a full build are not in a building-only run.

building_v43._comment: styles, balanced by builder._deficit: form_lines (`Küçə:` then `Ev:` / `Ev nömrəsi:` lines beside `Mərtəbə:` / `Otaq:` / `Kabinet:`), number_first (`23, Nizami küçəsi`), numero (`Nizami küçəsi, №23` beside `otaq №12`), count (a real address beside `9 mərtəbəli` / `3 otaqlı` / `12 kabinet`, unlabelled), building_count (a real address beside `120 ev var` / `30 bina tikilib`, unlabelled; red-team rule #136). ev_rate: `ev N` beside a floor; numero_doc_rate: a document `№` beside the address `№`
building_v43._form_comment: form_lines: form_decoy_line_rate, of a `Mərtəbə:` / `Otaq:` / `Kabinet:` line right under the building line (else the look-alike in a sentence of its own); form_end_rate, of the other forms that END the document on the building number (v4.2 misses a plain `Ev: 14` there, and finds it once anything follows); form_intro_rate, of a line above the form

_frame_cap_comment: max_frame_share 0.06 of this batch (36 documents per frame in 600): the run holds one family only, and the batch is appended to v4.2's 142k train, where the full build's 3% cap allows far more per frame
